title: Help & User Guide
description: How to use Skladnik for your role — sign in, daily tasks, and what to do when something is missing.
searchEmpty: No tasks match that search. Try another word, or open your role guide.
ownerFullGuideNote: You are viewing the full {{role}} guide so you can train or support your team. These steps describe what that role can do — not extra permissions on your account.
otherRoleHint: Step-by-step instructions for this role stay with people who have it. Ask them when you need help with those tasks.

signIn.title: Sign in
body: Open the Skladnik website and choose Login, or go to the login page.
Enter your email and password, then tap Log in to dashboard.
If your company uses Google sign-in, you can continue with Google instead.
After a successful login you land on Overview for your company.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
body: On the login screen, tap Forgot password?
Enter the email for your store account and tap Send reset link.
Check your email for a link (it expires in one hour), open it, and choose a new password of at least 8 characters.
Then log in again with the new password.

navigate.title: Find your way around
body: The top bar shows your active site, notifications, language, and your profile menu.
Switch site with the location chip next to the Skladnik logo when you work at more than one place.
Your role decides which menu items you see. Missing items usually mean your role does not include that job.
desktop: Use the left sidebar: Workspace for day-to-day work, System for Audit and Settings.
Owners, site managers, and staff with receive rights also get Photograph invoice at the bottom of the sidebar.
mobile: Use the bottom dock for your five main actions (they change by role).
Open your profile picture for the rest of the menu, Settings, and Log out.
There is no separate hamburger menu — the profile menu holds overflow links.

notifications.title: Notifications
body: Tap the bell in the top bar to open Actionable Notices.
Notices point to things that need attention (for example pending documents or stock alerts).
Tap a notice to open the related screen when a link is available.

account.title: Account settings
body: Open Settings from the sidebar (desktop) or your profile menu.
On Account you can see your name, company, role, and active site, change your password, and log out.
Changing your password signs other devices out. You need your current password and a new one of at least 8 characters.

desktopMobile.title: Desktop and phone
body: The same account works on laptop and phone. Pull down on the main screen to refresh data.
On a phone, prefer the bottom dock and the profile menu. Tables often become cards on small screens.
If you are offline, a banner explains that you are seeing saved data; photos upload when you are back online.

permissions.title: When a feature is unavailable
body: Menus and buttons you are not allowed to use are hidden. Opening a blocked link usually sends you back to Overview.
Some Settings tabs show owner-only messages if you can view but not edit.
If you need a missing action, ask an Owner (or the role listed in Choose role) — roles are fixed and cannot be customized per person beyond site assignment and till price override.

OWNER.blurb: Runs the whole company: users, sites, catalog, stock, till, reports, VAT, and subscription.
OWNER.askWhen: Ask an Owner to invite users, change company settings, set up sites, manage the product catalog, activate a subscription, or reverse posted documents.
OWNER.areas: Overview, Documents, Stock, Transfer, Stocktake, Reorder, Products, Expiry, Till, Sales, Recipes, Reports, VAT, Audit, and all Settings.

SITE_MANAGER.blurb: Runs day-to-day operations for assigned sites: receive, post, transfer, stocktake, till, and reports.
SITE_MANAGER.askWhen: Ask a Site manager to post goods receipts after review, run stocktakes and transfers, manage recipes, or void a sale.
SITE_MANAGER.areas: Overview, Documents, Stock, Transfer, Stocktake, Reorder, Products (minimum stock), Expiry, Till, Sales, Recipes, Reports, and Account / Sites settings.

STAFF.blurb: Receives goods, photographs invoices, writes off stock, and checks expiry — without using the till.
STAFF.askWhen: Ask Staff to photograph a delivery, enter a receipt draft, submit it for review, or write off damaged or expired goods.
STAFF.areas: Overview, Documents, Stock, Reorder, Products (view), Expiry, Write-off, Photo queue, and Account settings.

CASHIER.blurb: Sells at the till and reviews their own sales. Does not create stock documents.
CASHIER.askWhen: Ask a Cashier to ring up a sale or check their receipts for the day.
CASHIER.areas: Overview, Stock, Expiry, Till, Sales (own receipts), Reorder, Products (view), and Account settings.

ACCOUNTANT.blurb: Reads and exports financials, VAT, Annex 38 audit files, and document archives across the company.
ACCOUNTANT.askWhen: Ask an Accountant for reports, VAT filings, export layouts, or the monthly Annex 38 file.
ACCOUNTANT.areas: Overview, Documents (read), Stock (read), Sales, Reports, VAT, Audit, company settings (read), and Activity log.

ownerSites.title: Add or edit a site
steps: Open Settings, then Sites.
Tap Add site (or edit an existing row).
Enter the name and site type, then save.
Deactivate a site only when it should no longer be used.
needed: Site type (store, warehouse, kitchen, bar, and so on)
ownerSites.next: The site appears in the location switcher for users who have access.
notes: Only Owners can add or deactivate sites. Other roles can view the list.

ownerInvite.title: Invite a team member
steps: Open Settings → Users.
Tap Invite (or Add).
Enter their email, choose a role, and pick sites if the role is not Owner or Accountant.
Send the invite and share the link if needed.
They open the invite link, create a password, and join your company.
needed: Site access for managers, staff, and cashiers
ownerInvite.next: A pending invite appears until they join. You can resend or revoke it.
notes: Owner and Accountant see all sites. Other roles need at least one site.
If you hit the user limit, activate a higher plan under Settings → Subscription first.

ownerReceive.title: Photograph or receive a delivery
steps: Confirm the active site in the top bar.
Photograph the invoice or start Receive goods / New document.
Review the header and lines, fix matches if needed, then save the draft.
desktop: Use Photograph invoice in the sidebar, or Documents → New document.
Attach photos, check lines, and keep the draft until you are ready to post.
mobile: Tap Scan on the bottom dock, or Receive.
Use the camera or choose a photo, then review lines on the document screen.
ownerReceive.next: The document stays as a draft (or moves to review) until you post it to stock.
notes: Unknown products can be created for review from a scan line.

ownerPost.title: Post a document to stock
steps: Open Documents and select the draft or review document.
Check quantities, products, batches, and expiry.
Tap Post when everything looks correct (or Submit for review first if you want a second look).
Use Cancel on a draft you no longer need.
needed: No blocking errors on the document
ownerPost.next: Stock updates and the document becomes Posted. Posted documents cannot be edited — reverse them if you must undo.
notes: Reversing a posted document is for Owners and Site managers only.

ownerProducts.title: Manage the product catalog
steps: Open Products.
Add a product, or open one to edit name, unit, group, barcodes, and costs.
Approve pending products created from scans.
Archive products you no longer sell.
ownerProducts.next: New products can match on the next invoice scan and appear in stock and till search.
notes: Site managers may change minimum stock only — full catalog edits need an Owner.

ownerTransfer.title: Transfer stock between sites
steps: Open Transfer.
Choose from and to sites.
Add product lines and quantities.
Confirm Transfer.
needed: Products with enough stock at the source
ownerTransfer.next: Stock moves out of the source site and into the destination.
notes: Staff and Cashiers cannot create transfers.

ownerStocktake.title: Run a stocktake
steps: Open Stocktake and start a count.
Enter counted quantities (scan or search products as needed).
Optionally zero uncounted lines.
Post adjustments when the count is finished, or discard the count.
ownerStocktake.next: Posted variances adjust on-hand stock for that site.
notes: Only Owners and Site managers can run stocktakes.

ownerTill.title: Sell at the till
steps: Open Till for the active site.
Scan or search products into the cart.
Choose payment and tap Charge.
Print or share the receipt if needed.
desktop: Open Till from the sidebar.
Build the cart, charge, then open Sales if you need the receipt later.
mobile: Open Till from the sidebar or profile menu (Owners), or use quick actions on Overview.
Complete Charge on the till screen.
ownerTill.next: A sale is recorded and stock decreases. Managers can void a sale from Sales when needed.
notes: Price override depends on company Stock rules. Accountants cannot use the till.

ownerReports.title: Run and export reports
steps: Open Reports and pick a report (turnover, stock value, write-offs, and others).
Set the period and filters.
Use CSV, Excel, or Print / PDF.
Optional: manage export layouts under Reports → layouts.
ownerReports.next: You get an on-screen report and can download a file.
notes: Document archive (ZIP of original scans) is under Reports for Owners and Accountants.

ownerVat.title: Work with VAT
steps: Open VAT.
Review the return, purchase and sales ledgers, and filings for the period.
Generate or download NRA files when your period is ready.
Company VAT settings are edited under company settings (Owner).
ownerVat.next: Files and filings are ready for your accountant workflow.
notes: Site managers do not see VAT. Accountants can work filings; only Owners change core VAT settings.

ownerOpening.title: Post opening stock
ownerOpening.where: Opening stock (from Stock empty state or mobile menu)
steps: Open Opening stock for the site.
Enter quantities and unit costs for catalog products.
Post opening stock.
ownerOpening.next: On-hand stock is seeded for that site.
notes: Only Owners can post opening stock.
It locks after the site’s first real posted document — set it up early.

ownerSubscription.title: Activate a subscription code
steps: Open Settings → Subscription.
Paste the activation code from your invoice.
Confirm the preview (new, renew, upgrade, or downgrade).
Activate.
ownerSubscription.next: Plan, seat limit, and expiry update for the company.
notes: Expired subscriptions can still view and export, but writes may be locked.

mgrReceive.title: Receive goods at your site
steps: Select your site.
Photograph the invoice or start Receive.
Check lines and save the draft.
desktop: Use Photograph invoice or Documents → New document.
Review OCR lines, then keep the draft or post.
mobile: Use Scan or Receive on the bottom dock.
Finish the document on the Documents screen.
mgrReceive.next: Draft is ready for you to post, or for review if someone submitted it.
notes: You cannot change company users, VAT settings, or the full product catalog.

mgrPost.title: Post or reverse documents
steps: Open a draft or review document for your site.
Verify lines, then Post.
To undo a posted document, use Reverse when available.
mgrPost.next: Stock updates on post. Reverse creates the correcting movement.
notes: Staff may submit paper receipts for your review — they cannot post those themselves.

mgrWriteoff.title: Write off stock
steps: Open Write-off.
Choose a reason (expired, damaged, spoiled, lost, or other).
Add lines and optional evidence photo.
Confirm Write off.
desktop: Start Write-off from Overview or open the write-off screen.
Complete reason and lines, then confirm.
mobile: Tap Write-off on the bottom dock.
Finish the form and confirm.
needed: Products and quantities at the active site
mgrWriteoff.next: Write-off posts immediately and removes stock.
notes: This action cannot be edited afterwards — reverse from Documents if you must undo.

mgrTransfer.title: Transfer between sites
steps: Open Transfer.
Pick from/to sites and lines.
Confirm Transfer.

mgrStocktake.title: Count stock
steps: Start a count for the site.
Enter counted quantities.
Post adjustments or discard.

mgrTill.title: Use the till
steps: Open Till.
Add products, charge, and take payment.
desktop: Open Till from the sidebar.
Charge and review Sales as needed.
mobile: Open Till from the menu or Overview quick action.
Complete Charge on the till screen.
notes: You may void sales. Price override follows company Stock rules.

mgrMinstock.title: Set minimum stock for reorder
steps: Open Products and select an item.
Change the minimum stock for your site.
Save.
mgrMinstock.next: Reorder suggestions use the new minimum.
notes: You cannot create or archive catalog products — ask an Owner.

mgrRecipes.title: Maintain recipes (café / kitchen)
steps: Open Recipes.
Create a new recipe or open an existing dish.
Add ingredients and quantities, then Save recipe.
mgrRecipes.next: The till can sell the dish and deduct ingredients according to the recipe.

mgrReports.title: Check reports and margins
steps: Open Reports for stock and sales summaries.
Open Sales → Margins when you need margin detail.
Export CSV or Excel as needed.
mgrReports.next: You see company/site performance you are allowed to view.
notes: VAT, Audit, and document archive are Owner / Accountant only.

staffScan.title: Photograph a supplier invoice
steps: Select your site.
Open Scan and take or choose a photo.
Wait for lines to appear, then check matches.
desktop: Use Photograph invoice in the sidebar or Overview.
Review the document draft after OCR finishes.
mobile: Tap Scan in the center of the bottom dock.
Use the camera or library, then review the draft.
staffScan.next: A draft document is created for you to fix and submit.
notes: You can edit only your own drafts.
If you are offline, the photo waits in the photo queue until upload.

staffReceive.title: Enter a delivery without a photo
steps: Tap Receive (or New document for a receipt).
Fill the header and add lines.
Save the draft.
desktop: Start Receive from Overview or Documents.
Add lines manually, then save.
mobile: Tap Receive on the bottom dock.
Complete the form on the new document screen.
staffReceive.next: Your draft is ready to Submit for review.
notes: You cannot create transfers, stocktakes, or opening stock.

staffSubmit.title: Submit a receipt for review
steps: Open your draft document.
Check every line.
Tap Submit for review.
needed: Your own draft with complete lines
staffSubmit.next: A Site manager or Owner posts it to stock. You cannot post paper receipts yourself.
notes: After submit, you cannot edit or cancel that document — ask a manager.
Write-offs are different: you post those directly.

staffWriteoff.title: Write off expired or damaged goods
steps: Open Write-off.
Choose a reason and add lines.
Confirm Write off.
desktop: Start Write-off from Overview.
Confirm to post immediately.
mobile: Tap Write-off on the dock.
Confirm to post immediately.
notes: You will not see purchase costs or stock value — that is by design.

staffStock.title: Check stock and expiry
steps: Open Check stock (or Stock) to see quantities.
Open Expiring to sell or write off soon-to-expire batches.
Open a product from Stock for movement history when needed.
staffStock.next: You know what is on the shelf and what to use first.
notes: Cost and value columns stay hidden for Staff.

staffPending.title: Create a pending product from a scan line
staffPending.where: Documents → open your draft → line action
steps: On a scan line with no match, create a product from the line.
Fill the required name and unit details.
Save — the product waits for manager/owner approval.
staffPending.next: The line can use the pending product; an Owner or Site manager reviews it in Products.
notes: You cannot edit the full catalog or archive products.

staffQueue.title: Retry photos in the photo queue
staffQueue.where: Photo queue badge in the top bar
steps: Tap the photo queue badge when photos are waiting.
Upload now, retry failed items, or discard bad photos.
Finish the related document when the photo is attached.
staffQueue.next: Photos attach to documents and OCR can run.
notes: Logging out while photos are queued asks you to confirm.

cashTill.title: Ring up a sale
steps: Open Till.
Scan or search products.
Choose payment and Charge.
desktop: Open Till from the sidebar.
Complete Charge.
mobile: Tap Till in the center of the bottom dock.
Complete Charge.
cashTill.next: Receipt is saved under Sales. Stock decreases.
notes: You cannot create documents or photograph invoices.
You do not see purchase costs. Price changes follow company rules.

cashSales.title: Review your sales
steps: Open Sales.
Check the day report and open a receipt for details.
cashSales.next: You see your own sales for the selected day.
notes: Cashiers only see their own sales, not everyone’s. Voiding a sale needs a manager.

cashStock.title: Check stock or expiry before selling
steps: Open Stock or Expiring from the dock.
Confirm quantity or sell-by before you ring the item.
cashStock.next: You avoid selling out-of-stock or expired goods when possible.

accReports.title: Export operational and financial reports
steps: Open Reports from the dock or sidebar.
Choose a report and period.
Download CSV or Excel, or print PDF.
Create or edit export layouts if you need a custom column set.
notes: You cannot create stock documents or use the till.

accArchive.title: Download original document scans
steps: Open Reports, then Archive.
Set the period and preview.
Download ZIP.
needed: Documents with attached photos in the period
accArchive.next: You get a ZIP of original invoice images/PDFs.
notes: Only Owners and Accountants can use the archive.

accVat.title: Prepare VAT filings
steps: Open VAT.
Review return, ledgers, and manual entries for the period.
Generate filings / NRA files (DEKLAR, POKUPKI, PRODAGBI) when ready.
Mark submitted according to your process.
accVat.next: Filing artifacts are available to download or archive.
notes: Core VAT company settings are Owner-only. Ask an Owner if settings look wrong.

accAudit.title: Generate Annex 38 audit file
steps: Open Audit.
Choose site and month.
Review checks, then Generate XML.
Use the Orders / Refunds / Versions / Archive tabs as needed.
needed: Posted e-shop sales for the month
accAudit.next: XML is ready for NRA submission workflows.
notes: Site-level Annex 38 settings may require an Owner.

accSales.title: Review company sales
steps: Open Sales.
Inspect the day report and open receipts.
Use Margins when you need margin analysis.
accSales.next: You see sales across the company for reporting.
notes: You cannot void sales — ask a Site manager or Owner.

accDocs.title: Read documents and activity
steps: Open Documents to review headers, lines, and status.
Open Settings → Activity log for an audit trail of important actions.
accDocs.next: You can verify what was posted and by whom.
notes: Creating, posting, or reversing documents is not available for Accountants.

missingMenu.title: I cannot see a menu item
missingMenu.cause: Usually a permission limit: your role does not include that area, so Skladnik hides it.
missingMenu.fix: Check Choose role for who owns that job. Ask an Owner to change your role or assign the right sites. On mobile, also open your profile menu — some links live there instead of the dock.

pageRedirect.title: The page sends me back to Overview
pageRedirect.cause: You opened a link your role cannot use. The app redirects instead of showing an error page.
pageRedirect.fix: Use a screen from your own menu. If you still need that page, ask someone with the right role.

cannotCreate.title: I cannot create, edit, or delete
cannotCreate.cause: Write actions are role-based. Cashiers cannot create documents; Staff cannot edit the catalog; Accountants are mostly read-only; many Settings writes are Owner-only.
cannotCreate.fix: Confirm your role under Settings → Account. Ask an Owner or Site manager for the write action you need.

needsApproval.title: My document is waiting on someone else
needsApproval.cause: Staff submit paper receipts for review. Managers or Owners post them. Pending products also need review.
needsApproval.fix: Tell a Site manager or Owner which document or product is waiting. Write-offs you create as Staff post immediately and do not wait for approval.

formBlocked.title: I cannot submit a form
formBlocked.cause: Validation errors (missing fields, future dates, empty lines) or subscription / seat limits can block saving.
formBlocked.fix: Read the red messages on the form. Fix required fields. If you see a subscription or user-limit banner, ask an Owner to activate a code or free a seat.

reportMissing.title: Reports or export are missing
reportMissing.cause: Reports need a financial manager role (Owner, Site manager, or Accountant). Archive and some layouts need Owner or Accountant. Cashiers and Staff do not get the Reports hub.
reportMissing.fix: Ask an Owner, Site manager, or Accountant to run the export, or to change your role if that is intended.

mobileControl.title: I see a button on desktop but not on my phone
mobileControl.cause: Mobile uses a role-specific bottom dock. Extra screens are under your profile menu.
mobileControl.fix: Tap your avatar, open the item there, or rotate/widen the screen. Photograph invoice is Scan on the dock for Staff and managers.
